name: THRESHOLD WIRE NETWORK
description: A licensed but aggressively independent broadcast network operating from a cluster of transmitters along the Gray Zone boundary, serving Tier 1 and lower Tier 2 audiences with flat-screen and low-bandwidth holographic content. Threshold Wire produces its own local news, community information, and original drama on minimal budgets, with a reputation for covering the Gray Zone conditions that no Vantablack subsidiary will touch. The network has survived three attempted license revocations.
cultural_impact: Became the primary trusted news source for millions of Tier 1 and the Gray Zone residents, filling an information vacuum that corponation media had deliberately left empty.
story_hooks: Threshold Wire's license renewal is being blocked by a technicality that appears to have been inserted into the regulatory framework within the last six months — someone is trying to shut it down legally.
The network's archive of the Gray Zone displacement footage going back to 2188 is the only existing record of several events that corponation media erased — and someone has just realized this.
A Threshold Wire correspondent disappears three days before she was scheduled to broadcast a report on corponation-controlled water access in the outer the Gray Zone blocks.
